component.name: Catfyn
component.summary: A no-nonsense Jellyfin and Plex client for TV screens

description.p: Catfyn plays films and series from your own Jellyfin or Plex server on a TV, driven with nothing more than arrow keys, OK and Back. It finds servers on your network, signs in to Plex with a short code, keeps several accounts on both kinds of server, resumes where you stopped and offers the next episode when the credits start. Playback is done by mpv.
